name: Minamoto no Yoritomo
source:
The Seiryu of Heaven from the realm of Ōka.

Leader of the Genji clan. 24 years old.
With the disposition of a cold man, he rarely reveals his emotions.
He never misses a day of training, preparing for the upcoming war with Heike.
Due to his honest nature, his vassals hold a sincere loyalty towards him.

Character Designer : Bekko

[Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/chara01_minamotonoyoritomo.html]official website[/url]]

[Spoiler]His real name is Aoki Yuma and originally came from the same world with protagonist. 

The god Hachiman granted Yoritomo's dying wish and found Yuma having the same face and age with the real one. Hachiman sent eleven years old Yuma to the realm of Ouka. Before passing away and vanishing, the real one begging Yuma to become Minamoto no Yoritomo and lead Genji. He had no choice to abandoned his real identity.

No one know Yuma is the fake one until he revealed himself in his own route[/Spoiler]
